children: TRAVELERS COMPANIES, INC. reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $12.41B, essentially flat year‑over‑year, net income of $1.92B and diluted earnings per share of $9.04, reflecting modest earnings growth versus the prior-year quarter — 10-Q Summary.
Revenue: $12.41B for 3Q 2026, compared with $12.47B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (0.5%).
Net income: $1.92B for 3Q 2026, compared with $1.89B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 1.5%.
Diluted EPS: $9.04 for 3Q 2026, compared with $8.24 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 9.7%.
Consolidated earned premiums were stable year over year; slight declines were driven by Personal Insurance while Business and Bond & Specialty segments posted modest growth.
Management shifted the portfolio through the divestiture of Canadian operations and expanded surety, management liability and cyber quota share cessions.
Underwriting trends showed improved combined ratios, though underlying margins faced pressure from higher expenses, catastrophe volatility and prior‑year reserve development.
Net investment income rose on higher yields and reinvestment expectations, supporting operating cash flow.
Operational actions included asbestos reserve reviews, renewal and expansion of quota share reinsurance, and significant share repurchases to optimize capital.
